notes.title: Finger Party Announced!
notes.content:
Hello!

New game announced: Finger Party!

Not to spoil the secrets of the Finger Party too much by blabbing about them here, please check the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3430630/Finger_Party/]Steam page for Finger Party[/url]!

I'm happy that the game has most of the components I want it to have, but there is still room for more content, balancing, general improvements and making things feel extra juicy!

There might be a demo coming up for the next Steam Next Fest on February 24th (2025), which I hope everyone will check out, if I'll get it out on time.

The game has progressed quite a lot during the last months from the early prototypes, since I've had some sort of internal timetable to release it at some point.

I'm also happy that there is now something to follow my previous game: "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1613580/ARRIVAL_ZERO_EARTH/]Arrival: Zero Earth[/url]"!

More news to come!

Please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3430630/Finger_Party/]wishlist Finger Party[/url] here on Steam to hear about future updates and when the game is finally released.

Thanks!

- jounitus

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3430630/Finger_Party/
